import json
from copy import deepcopy
from work import evaluate

def check(request, policy, expected):
    rb=deepcopy(request); pb=deepcopy(policy)
    actual=evaluate(request, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (request, actual, expected)
    assert request == rb and policy == pb
    assert set(actual) == {'ok','value','reason'}
